source.primary: Cohen, Jeavons, Jonsson, Koubarakis, Building tractable disjunctive constraints, JACM 47(5), 2000, DOI 10.1145/355483.355485
source.definition_7: A set of constraints has the guaranteed satisfaction property if every finite subset has a solution.
source.secondary_theorem_correspondence: Broxvall, Jonsson, Renz, Disjunctions, independence, refinements, Artificial Intelligence 140 (2002), DOI 10.1016/S0004-3702(02)00224-2

delta_sheet.proof: M_+++ requires x+y+z>=2 while M_--- requires x+y+z<=1.
